notes.title: V.2019.1.0
notes.content:
Hi!

I have removed the DLCs but, I don't want the content to get buried with it. So, I have decided to release a new version of the game including the content from the DLCs.

If you own the DLCs I really appreciate your support! And as a bonus for you I will give you and item for the game Andarilho.
[list][*]If you owned the DLC Custom Lasers you will receive a Pink paint for the Sports Car.
[*]If you owned the DLC Extra Levels you will receive a Black paint for the Sports Car.[/list]

I hope you guys enjoy the it!




SC Jogos

notes.title: DLCs will be removed from the store.
notes.content:
Hello guys, I'm here to announce that I have decided to remove all the DLCs from the store. If you already own one or more DLCs the content from these DLCs will continue to be available for you.

After 2 years of feedback from the players (mostly negative) about the DLCs and after some considerations I have decided to remove it permanently from the store.

[b]The following games will be affected:[/b]

[h1]Andarilho:[/h1]
For the game Andarilho, the DLCs will be removed but, the content from it will be added to the game. If you own a DLC, you will receive one or more items on your Steam inventory relative to that DLC. A new update will be released soon and I will announce later all the changes and new items for the game.


[h1]Barro[/h1]
For Barro, the extra tracks will be available only for those who own the DLC and it will no longer be possible to buy it in the future.


[h1]Ninja Stealth[/h1]
For Ninja Stealth, the extra content was only cosmetic and it will be available only for those who already own the DLC.


[h1]Ninja Stealth 2[/h1]
Like Ninja Stealth, the extra content was only cosmetic and it will be available only for those who already own the DLC.


[h1]Ninja Stealth 3[/h1]
The extra levels and the laser customisation will be available only for those who already own the DLC. It doesn't interferes on the main game.


[b]The following DLCs will no longer be available for purchase:[/b]

ːns_redːAndarilho - Aliens
ːns_redːAndarilho - Guns
ːns_redːAndarilho - Vehicles
ːns_redːAndarilho - Zombies 

ːns_redːBarro - Track Pack 1
ːns_redːBarro - Track Pack 2

ːns_redːNinja Stealth - Supporter Edition 

ːns_redːNinja Stealth 2 - Golden Edition

ːns_redːNinja Stealth 3 - Custom Lasers
ːns_redːNinja Stealth 3 - Extra Levels #1



If you have any questions, feel free to contact me and I will be happy to help you.




SC Jogos
